bio: Set against a beautiful mountain backdrop, this establishment is run with great dedication by brothers Matthias and Lars Michel – Matthias manages the hotel, which boasts tastefully designed, comfortable rooms, and Lars is the restaurant's charming maître d'. In the kitchen, Aurélien Mettler and his team conjure up the modern and ambitious Chef's Choice set menu, which comprises four to six courses. For this, they use seasonal produce and skilfully incorporate Scandinavian and Japanese influences. Sustainability is a key consideration in the selection of the ingredients. If you would like a vegetarian version, it is best to specify this when making your reservation.
